executable.title: Stripe Filter Program
executable.acknowledgements: This program uses Insight Toolkit (ITK) library.

image.name: outputImage
image.label: Output Image Volume
image.description: Path to the output image (created image with stripes).

parameters.label: Stripe Settings
parameters.description: Parameters defining the stripe geometry and intensity

integer.name: stripeDirection
integer.description: The axis to stripe along (0-based index)
integer.label: Stripe Direction

integer.name: stripeValue
integer.description: The pixel intensity value for the stripe [0, 10000]
integer.label: Stripe Value

integer.name: stripeWidth
integer.description: The width of the stripe in voxels (must be strictly less than stripeDistance)
integer.label: Stripe Width

integer.name: stripeDistance
integer.description: The distance in voxels from the start of one stripe to the next (must be strictly greater than stripeWidth)
integer.label: Stripe Distance
